name: limited drop vs plain email, same list
_read_me_first: Run `npm run ab:test -- --preflight --list-size <your list> --metric orders` BEFORE editing this. On a list under 41,234 (20,617 per arm, which lets 5% bounce) it will say TOO SMALL: send the plain email and stop, and do not send this as an experiment. Fill in decidedOn and the planned dates, replace baselineRate with Joyisfree's own CAMPAIGN placed-order rate if you have one (never a flow), then run `npm run ab:test -- --check --file agency/experiments/drop-vs-email.json` before sending anything.

preRegistered.baselineSource: SUMMARY, not verified: Klaviyo 2026 benchmark, campaign placed-order rate per delivered email 0.12% clothing and accessories, 0.13% home and garden; older Klaviyo apparel 0.07%; Omnisend 2025 all ecommerce 0.08%. Range 0.07% to 0.13%. Taken from search summaries; the pages were not opened. Flows run 15 to 20 times higher and must never be used here.
